message: Can you tell me what 3 gaps are close to each otherß
answer: The closest trio is three Mamba gaps that are really the same worry stated three ways: "Evaluation limited to small model sizes", "Whether Mamba maintains advantage at larger parameter scales", and "Scaling may involve undisclosed engineering challenges" — all of them say Mamba has only been tested small and whether it holds up at scale is open. The next tightest cluster is about the attention mechanism itself: the dot-product compatibility function, reduced effective resolution from averaging, and local restricted attention for large inputs. There's a third around DDPM likelihood: DDIM likelihood never evaluated, hybrid objectives sacrificing optimal log-likelihood, and NLL scaling not following a clean power law. Want me to work from one of these trios — for example, bundle the three Mamba scaling gaps into a single candidate idea?
